text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. The entire academy
seems to be buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Encouraged by that atmosphere, some girls seem to have gathered the courage to give chocolates even to the usually unapproachable Student Council members—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A considerable number of cardboard boxes
were stacked against the wall of the student council room...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Seeing this sight really makes me feel the season. Valentine's Day has come around once again."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Strictly speaking, it also includes all sorts
of sweets, trinkets, and the like, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If we're going by what you mean,
then all of this is chocolate gifted to us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, everyone knows who we are. Higher name recognition leads to a larger sample size, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In a sense, it's probably closer to entering just for the sake of the experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, girls around this age
are always searching for someone to look up to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think "Emperor"
is a rather fitting title for her?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I am an Umamusume of age, after all.
Aside from analysis, I have emotional impulses too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Actually, all of these chocolates were left in front of the student council room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I imagine it must have been intimidating to approach us, yet she still mustered up her courage... What an admirable spirit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pure and lovely, truly endearing.
It is only natural that one would love everything about her.
choice_data_list: You have such a gentle smile and kind words about you right now.
You have such a gentle, kind expression right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'm talking about my own student.
You can hardly blame me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must get to sorting out
all these chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but I need a moment.
Feel free to take a break or—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, but still—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Well, since you share the same aspirations as I do,
I'm sure everyone would forgive you for touching these feelings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'm in your debt.
Shall we begin right away?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: First, I'd like to arrange the pre-made goods in order of their expiration dates. We can repurpose the existing cardboard boxes—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, that should about do it for tidying up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer-kun, we finished in no time.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a short break.
Could you open that desk drawer over there for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the drawer right beside me—
there was a square box inside.
It appeared to be a tablet-style chocolate bar.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just a little token of my appreciation.
It's a treat that goes well with coffee.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Not to brag, but I'm well aware I've had more Valentine's experience than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
From the chocolate brands I learned about in the process,
I've handpicked these to suit your tastes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I personally guarantee the taste.
Go ahead, have a little bite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate I snacked on during the break
was rich in cacao and absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, I wanted to eat it again and looked it up, only to be astonished to discover it was quite a luxury brand...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, this is a bit of a problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. It's just that despite you going out of your way to help,
I foolishly have no token of gratitude prepared.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, what to do."
"Hold on, let me think."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It seems I have no choice.
I shall now confide a secret of mine to you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The truth is—I can use magic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you think this is mere idle talk?
Yet, you too must have heard of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"A tale of magic-wielding royalty.
If I were their descendant—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, what's the plan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The sheer intensity is so convincing,
it doesn't sound like a joke at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun,
allow me to unveil my magic to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
First, hold out your hand
and close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Honest, aren't you?
Now then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pop)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Come now, open your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I open my eyes, there is a present adorned with a golden ribbon in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's,
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Chocolates from me.
Please, accept them."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I say. Perhaps I laid on
the theatrics a bit too thick."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have much experience
giving chocolates out privately, you see."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I built up the suspense a little too much.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did.
On that chocolate, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's magic guaranteed to put a beaming smile on your face.
Look forward to tasting it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, when I tried a bite of the chocolate she gave me...
I couldn't help but smile.
